title: Resource Management

nodes.text: Incident Controller provides direction to Agency Commanders on resource allocation

evidence.source_text: The Incident Controller is responsible for providing direction to the Agency Commanders of the agencies responding to the incident on where the agency resources are to work and the function they are to perform.

nodes.text: Agency Commanders task agency personnel and ensure safe systems of work

evidence.source_text: Agency Commanders are responsible for tasking their agency personnel and for ensuring they follow safe systems of work.
The Incident Controller should initially request additional local resources through Agency Commanders.

nodes.text: Request additional local resources through Agency Commanders

evidence.source_text: The Incident Controller should initially request additional local resources through Agency Commanders.
Where agencies are unable to provide sufficient resources from the local area, the Incident Controller should seek additional resources through the Regional Controller.

nodes.text: Seek additional resources through the Regional Controller

evidence.source_text: Where agencies are unable to provide sufficient resources from the local area, the Incident Controller should seek additional resources through the Regional Controller.

nodes.text: Regional Controller prioritizes resource deployment across the Region

evidence.source_text: The Regional Controller, in consultation with Regional Agency Commanders, will prioritise resource deployment across the Region.

nodes.text: Regional Controller reallocates resources within the Region

evidence.source_text: This may include reallocating resources within their Region.

nodes.text: Can the Region supply the required resources?

evidence.source_text: Where the Region is unable to supply the resources required, the Regional Controller will seek resources from the State Response Controller.

nodes.text: Seek resources from the State Response Controller

evidence.source_text: Where the Region is unable to supply the resources required, the Regional Controller will seek resources from the State Response Controller.

nodes.text: State Response Controller prioritizes resource deployment across the state

evidence.source_text: The State Response Controller, in consultation with State Agency Commanders, will prioritise resource deployment across the state and seek additional resources as required.

nodes.text: Seek other local support agency resources through IERC or MERC

evidence.source_text: Other local support agency resources are sought through the IERC or MERC in the first instance.

nodes.text: MERC escalates unfilled requests to RERC, then to EMC through SPLO

evidence.source_text: The MERC will escalate unfilled requests to the RERC, who will escalate unfilled requests to the EMC through the Senior Police Liaison Officer (SPLO).

nodes.text: EMC sources resources from other states, Commonwealth, and overseas

evidence.source_text: The EMC is responsible for sourcing resources from other states, the Commonwealth and from overseas and for authorising the deployment of Victorian response resources interstate and overseas.
This arrangement excludes resources obtained through established cross-border arrangements for first response.
